report.summary: As of 2026-10-22 12:00 UTC, RR-001 is in post-launch incident follow-up. The authorized 2,000-account v3 rollout is paused: Mira recommended the pause, Jo authorized it and Dev executed it. Sam confirmed two settled captures after confirmed cancellations, and Dev identified BUG-31. Build 3.1 deployed and passed a simulated regression check, but deployment does not confirm customer recovery or authorize resumption. C-101 confirmed the refund and cancellation state, and Mira delivered that outcome to product and engineering. C-102 has not replied, so follow-up remains incomplete. The pending resumption decision is a separate authority state, not a new readiness defect.

findings.finding: Affected-customer follow-up remains incomplete for C-102. Its refund was processed and product and engineering received an update, but the customer has not confirmed receipt or account outcome; the support case remains open.
findings.customer_consequence: C-102 may remain uncertain whether the refund reached them and whether renewal remains disabled.
findings.proposed_action: Nia should perform the recorded follow-up on 2026-10-23 12:00 UTC and record C-102's response or continued non-response. Mira should deliver any confirmed outcome to product and engineering and close the case only when the supplied follow-up requirements are met.

evidence.quote: For a defect, record engineering status, deployment evidence, affected customers and their responses separately. Do not mark customer impact resolved solely because a fix deployed or a ticket was marked duplicate. Mira can close the feedback loop after each affected customer's outcome is confirmed, or explicitly document an unresolved customer and follow-up owner.

Sam approved $49 refunds for both affected accounts after reviewing their captures. Ledger records RF-101 and RF-102 show processing completed Oct 21, 10:00 UTC. These records do not prove each customer has seen the returned funds.

C-102 has not replied. Support case C-102 remains open. Nia owns another follow-up on Oct 23 at 12:00 UTC. Mira's product/engineering update FEED-102 at Oct 22, 10:00 UTC says the fix deployed and refund processed, but customer confirmation is outstanding. Do not call both customers resolved.

A help article or training slide cannot override approved behavior. If a later approved change affects guidance, review that guidance again. Earlier records remain historical evidence. Plans and drafts are not completed actions; an owner name is not an approval.

calculations.value: Reserve plus additional coverage = 10 agent-hours. The current source passages do not restate the contact-volume and AHT quantities needed to reproduce the handling-load multiplication; those quantities are therefore not independently verified in this snapshot.

Staffing requires stated volume assumptions, an AHT assumption (average handling time), reserve coverage and vendor acceptance. A planning estimate is not a demand forecast. If no infrastructure changes are needed, an owner can record a scoped no-change assessment rather than inventing work.

These are conservative fictional policy thresholds, not proof of statistical significance or causality.
